quote: My husband and I have joined serenbliss and in true sense it has been a bliss. The warmth and enthusiasm with which Teacher Reshma teaches is commendable. Love the way she gives personal attention to each student, addressing everyone's medical condition and needs. Out personal favourite are pranayama and meditation sessions she incorporates during class. Highly recommend yoga sessions under her guidance. One is surely in safe hands❤️😊🙏🏻
author: Ashish and Avni Bhojani

quote: Wonderful variety in a class. I love the way you plan every class.
author: Ramya Srikanth

quote: Last couple of years of yoga under the guidance of Reshma from Serenebliss has been a beautiful and a seamless journey. She pays close attention to each students' physical ability whilst maintaining the momentum of a group learning experience. She gives equal importance to mindfulness and breathing practices which helps me take my physical practice to the next level. I have developed more self-awareness about my mind and body
author: Ramya

quote: Thank you so much for all your guidance and support. Despite my health issues, you were always so patient and thoughtful in offering variations, which made such a big difference to my practice. I really appreciate your kindness and dedication 🙏 I'm truly grateful for having such an amazing yoga teacher 🙏
author: Sonali Santosh
